_comment: Sources and mastering sets for scripts/fetch_audio.py; docs/AUDIO.md documents every field. fs_* sources are Freesound HQ previews (Ogg Vorbis ~192 kbps; originals need an API key + OAuth login), all CC0. sha256 is pinned on first fetch. Sets build assets/audio/<category>/<name>_<n>.ogg.
